knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A quote shows included items, excluded items and the assessment step, so the client understands what is and is not covered.
Structural and subfloor repair are outside the course and are excluded unless scoped and authorised separately.
A variation is recorded and approved in writing before the work changes.
The species, the existing finish and the board condition all affect the outcome, so an exact appearance cannot be promised.
The assessment and the applicable state rules decide whether licensed removal is needed, and a licensed person does that work where it is required.

practicalCriteria: Candidate prepares a quote for a sample floor that lists included, excluded and assessed items.
Candidate prices containment, extraction, clean-up and handover as separate lines using the business's approved method.
Candidate records a variation found on the sample inspection and obtains written approval before the scope changes.
Candidate records the licence position for the sample job.
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 80% correct (4 of 5). Practical sign-off is separate. A knowledge pass does not establish practical competence, and the practical criteria must be observed and recorded by an assessor. Pricing values are set by the business and are not part of this assessment.
evidenceRequired: Quote with included, excluded and assessed items
Licence position record for the job
Assessor review of the quote against the approved pricing method
stopWorkCriteria: Licensed removal priced as part of a normal timber job
